name: Algebraic Property Substitution
description: Replaces the graph-theoretic property (forming a triangle) with a strictly equivalent algebraic property: the adjacency matrix of the triplet having a determinant of 2. This forces the model to algebraically reduce the determinant to $2 \cdot e_1 \cdot e_2 \cdot e_3$ to realize it is a triangle finding problem, defeating models that rely on surface keywords.
